failure_case.reason: 17 unique reviewed photographs could not cover all topical narration intervals; the first interval had only 5 eligible photographs for 9 cuts.

change.behavior: Before voice synthesis, estimate per-scene duration by both word count and character count and require the existing unique relevant-photo scheduler to cover both estimates. Exact measured timing validation at render remains in place.

verification.regression: A 17-photo plan with 5 images for a long scene is rejected before voice; a fully relevant 17-photo control passes.

limitations: Word and character estimates do not replace measured TTS timing; render still performs exact interval assignment.
No new acceptance job, deployment, audio playback or HUMAN review is included in this checkpoint.
